{"schema":1,"channel":"stable","target":"windows-x86_64","repository":"faintestbreath/FileManager-Updates","version":"1.1.2","notes":"# FileManager 1.1.2

FileManager 1.1.2 keeps installation and recovery files out of the shared Programs folder.

- Application files stay in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\FileManager.
- Installer maintenance files, deployment locks, inventories, transaction journals, stages and backups now stay in %LOCALAPPDATA%\FileManagerDeployment.
- Existing v1.1.1 installations migrate their recognized deployment files safely. Original uninstall history and recovery data are retained outside Programs.
- Interrupted updates remain recoverable. Changed or unknown files stop installation for review instead of being deleted or overwritten.
- Notes, Favorites, fonts, keyboard shortcuts and personal settings remain separate and survive updates, rollback and uninstall.
- The verified-download workflow, Update/Later consent and safe installer working directory are preserved.

Finish file operations before choosing Update. Setup remains interactive and will not terminate a running FileManager. After Setup finishes, launch FileManager from the Start Menu.

The installer includes required third-party licenses, Microsoft runtime terms and dependencies. No settings-format change is required.
